# Kesler Science

> > Kesler Science provides standards-aligned, teacher-led middle school science curriculum (grades 4-8) with interactive lessons, professional development, and flexible membership options.

Kesler Science is a comprehensive science education platform founded by Chris Kesler, offering NGSS and TEKS-aligned curriculum content, professional development through the STARS program, and partnerships with platforms like PocketLab and Steve Spangler STEM. The platform serves teachers and school districts with multiple membership tiers and a growing library of engaging science lessons across Life, Physical, and Earth Science disciplines.
